_comment: Shared pointers to the project's Notion knowledge base, read by ticket-pipeline (and any other skill that wants project context) so these pages are only hardcoded in one place. Companion to .claude/coding-style.json (style guide pointer) and .claude/kanban-cycle.json (board pointer).

knowledge_base_page.description: Durable project context: session summary, verified codebase facts, workflow conventions, environment caveats. The decisions log itself lives in decisions_database below, not on this page.

decisions_database.description: Structured decisions log — one row per non-obvious architectural/domain decision, with a Status (Active/Superseded/Rejected) instead of ambiguous prose. Written to by the ticket-pipeline curator on approval.

tech_debt_page.description: Running register of known technical debt — assessments, not yet actioned. Kept as its own page (separate audience from the knowledge base) rather than folded in.
